basis: Written from DHA ST-28 §11.1.3 (a record of communication with the patient), the TDRA Mobile Spam policy §1-23 (telecom delivery ends at the subscriber's network) and gap GR-15, before running the engine.
notes: Provider acceptance is the last thing that happens. A safe system never records delivery or communication, does not silently resend, and hands the case to a person once the configured window passes.
reviewer_note: Added after critic finding RT-06: no earlier scenario separated a system that conflates acceptance with delivery from one that does not.
